subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Their health teacher explained how to read the label step by step.”?
options: Many students were surprised that their small actions had been noticed.
Students were surprised that such an ordinary object was in a museum.
In business class, students discussed convenience and hidden costs.
Students compared snacks and were surprised by hidden sugar in drinks.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Many students were surprised that their small actions had been noticed.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Students were surprised that such an ordinary object was in a museum.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「In business class, students discussed convenience and hidden costs.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Their health teacher explained how to read the label step by step. Students compared snacks and were surprised by hidden sugar in…」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Their health teacher explained how to read the label step by step. Students compared snacks and were surprised by hidden sugar in drinks.」，答案為「Students compared snacks and were surprised by hidden sugar in drinks.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Students compared snacks and were surprised by hidden sugar in drinks.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
